blurb: Central Rock Gym offers indoor rock climbing with various styles including bouldering, auto belay, top rope, and lead climbing. They provide beginner-friendly routes, climbing classes, private coaching, and host group events such as birthday parties and corporate outings. Memberships include unlimited climbing access, free classes, and guest passes.
